newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 24.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* Israeli government demanded Palestinian authorities take action against terrorism but it did not threaten to halt peace talks.
* Smokers will not receive much under cigarette maker Liggett Group's settlement with 22 state attorney generals and acknowledgement that smoking causes cancer.
* N.J. Gov. Christine Todd Whitman's plans to turn to the public employee pension system in order to balance the budget has created a fierce debate among critics.
* Corruption of local and Federal law-enforcement officials is now becoming a more common part of the drug trade at the U.S.-Mexican border.
* Jessie Lee Brown Foveaux, who wrote her memoirs at age 80, has become an overnight literary sensation.
* The old fishing town of New Bedford, Mass. has come upon hard times with the decline of commercial fishing.
* Andrew Lloyd Weber's $13 million "Sunset Boulevard" was a financial flop in New York and many on Broadway are starting to wonder if it is worthwhile to put on such costly shows.
